name: Picture grabber
description: Collect card art from anywhere: every picture on a web page (Pinterest, ArtStation, a booru, Reddit, any site) saved full size with its credit, and live mode – every picture you copy and every new screenshot is saved into the deck's art folder by itself.
author: MEZTKING
